P_NUM: How fast it ran, against every lizard on that stage, from 0 to 99. 90 means faster than 90 lizards in a hundred. P-NUM AGE compares it only with lizards its age. No P-Num means it didn't finish.
FIGURES: P-NUM: how fast it ran, 0 to 99. PLACE: where it finished. PRIZE: what it won. FALLS: times it was knocked down. KOS: others it knocked down. SPRINTS: where in the race it sprinted, start at the left.
ALIKE: Every two stages have a score for how alike they race: 1 the same, 0 unrelated, below 0 opposites. ALIKE AT LEAST counts only a lizard's races on stages at least that alike to the next race's.
ODDS: Each race's odds are skewed on purpose, a little up or down for each lizard. Read the form and you'll find lizards priced too long.
PLACE_BET: HOW DOES A PLACE BET PAY?
Your stake times the points for where it finished, divided by its rating. It pays more the higher it finishes, and makes a profit from the place shown.
RUN_OUT: WHAT IF I RUN OUT OF MONEY?
After each race you're topped up so you can always bet. Top-ups don't count towards leagues.
LEAGUES: By how much you've grown your money since the league began, not counting top-ups.
DNF: Did not finish. That race has no time, place or P-Num and isn't counted in averages.
AGE: Young lizards are still growing; old ones slow a little each season but get more patient. Each ages at its own pace.
FALLS: It was hit hard enough to go down. Up on a platform, it falls to the route below.
